# Marta Blangiardo

I am a professor of Biostatistics at Imperial College, in the Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics and I lead the Biostatistics and Data Science theme of the [MRC Centre for Environment and Health](https://environment-health.ac.uk/). I am part-time seconded at the Turing Institute, working with the RSS-TURING lab to provide accurate estimates of COVID-19 incidence and prevalence at Local Authority level. Since 2017 I hold an honorary academic appointment with PHE (now UKHSA).

My main interests are related on the methodological aspects of environmental exposure estimation and on spatial and spatio-temporal models for disease mapping and for risk assessment.

I have co-authored a book on the Integrated Nested Laplace approximation (INLA) for spatial and spatio-temporal applications: [Spatial and Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Models with R-INLA](https://www.google.co.uk/books/edition/Spatial_and_Spatio_temporal_Bayesian_Mod/kaYKCAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&printsec=frontcover)

Check out my research group page at <http://www.envstats.org>
